description: This file defines mock classes for unit testing, specifically for the IFrameRate interface and its notification component in the WPEFramework. It includes mock method declarations using Google Mock (gmock) for testing frame rate functionalities and notifications.

classes.name: FrameRateMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of the IFrameRate interface and video device events for testing frame rate controls.

classes.name: FrameRateNotificationMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of the IFrameRate::INotification interface for testing frame rate event notifications.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Mocks the registration of a notification callback.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Mocks the unregistration of a notification callback.

methods.name: SetCollectionFrequency
methods.description: Mocks setting the collection frequency for FPS measurement.

methods.name: StartFpsCollection
methods.description: Mocks starting the FPS collection process.

methods.name: StopFpsCollection
methods.description: Mocks stopping the FPS collection process.

methods.name: GetFrmMode
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the current frame mode.

methods.name: GetDisplayFrameRate
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the display frame rate.

methods.name: SetDisplayFrameRate
methods.description: Mocks setting the display frame rate.

methods.name: OnDisplayFrameratePreChange
methods.description: Mocks the event triggered before changing the display frame rate.

methods.name: OnDisplayFrameratePostChange
methods.description: Mocks the event triggered after changing the display frame rate.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Mocks adding a reference to the object.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Mocks releasing a reference to the object.

calls: MOCK_METHOD(hresult, SetDisplayFrameRate, (const string& framerate , bool& success), (override))
